InvocationHistory is exactly historyBefore of the actual PAGE executor. Its generator records the invocation metadata and only earlier queries/replies plus the preceding collector pending-after state. It excludes the new batch initial pending labels. invocationData projects the full flag, points, finite starting clock and first ID, with a harmless default when no invocation exists. restart_service must prove this history lies below the ambient product measurable space and that invocationData is history-measurable; these are conclusions, not new public assumptions. The bounded start search is nonanticipating on the common valid-service event: each previous batch finishes before the next batch rows are read.

For positive-mass E in the pre-invocation history, restrictedProbability is P(E)^(-1) times P restricted to E. restartOracle maps a single restricted original execution sample to a constant oracle tape, preserving all dependence across calls. liftRequest translates clocks and starts by the invocation clock, IDs by firstID, and single/pair points to the actual invocation points while retaining components and job kind. restartAnswer calls the original oracle at callStart+a, subtracts clock/ID offsets, and replaces values by zero for the zero objective. Matching IDs and nondecreasing legal clocks prevent underflow on valid paths. Control and elapsed clocks of each collector depend on labels and replies, not accumulated gradients, so the zero-objective collector reproduces the actual invocation after these translations. The original primitive service quantifies jointly measurably over every request and has one common full-measure tape event for every call/legal request. The translation preserves nonempty pending work, start<=clock, job work and deadlines, so its service conclusion applies also to hypothetical restarted requests. The zero objective makes the returned zero values exact. Unused current-batch private rows are independent of the earlier history and original oracle tape; firstID and callStart are determined by that history. Thus restricting by E and shifting the fresh row index preserves the conditional uniform assignment law, with a filtration containing the restricted scheduler sample and earlier rows. This supplies the stated FullFresh obligation even for a hypothetical full collector at a difference invocation. No completed-IID or elapsed-cost conclusion is assumed.
